name: Winter windflower
grown_as: A spring bulb (in fact a tuber) grown in drifts. Usually blue, but William's is pink, so it is drawn pink. ⚠️ CHECK the shade of pink.
habit: Low carpets 10 to 15 cm high of ferny divided leaves with daisy-like flowers held just above them.

leaf.arrangement: One or two leaves from the tuber on long stalks; on each flower stem a whorl of three smaller, stalked, divided leaves (the bracts) about halfway up
leaf.type: Compound: divided into three main parts, each deeply cut again into lobed, toothed segments
leaf.outline: Rounded to triangular overall, 3 to 6 cm across
leaf.base: The three main divisions meet at the top of the stalk
leaf.margin: Deeply cut; the segments with a few coarse, rounded teeth near their tips
leaf.veins: Palmate: from the top of the stalk into each division
leaf.surface: Smooth or slightly hairy, paler beneath

flower.petals: Nine to fifteen narrow, oblong, petal-like tepals with rounded tips, spreading flat in a single ring
flower.colour: Rose-pink (variety; most plants are mid blue, some white), paler or white towards the base
flower.centre: A ring of many yellow stamens round a small green knob of pistils, with a paler ring round it
flower.behind: No green sepals: the whorl of three divided leaf-bracts sits on the stem below the flower
flower.carried: Alone, facing upwards, on a slender stem just above the leaves; closes in dull weather

fruit: A small round knob of beaked seeds (achenes), green turning brown, on the stem, which bends over as it ripens.
seedling: Not drawn. Two small oval seed leaves, then a three-lobed leaf.

leaf: a leaf divided into three main parts on a long stalk
each part deeply cut into lobed segments with a few blunt teeth
bloom: nine to fifteen narrow pink tepals in a flat ring
a yellow centre of many stamens round a green knob
a paler ring between the pink and the yellow
bulb: a tuber: an irregular knobbly dark brown-black lump 1 to 3 cm, like a bit of dry wood
no papery skin, no clear top or bottom
shoots: divided leaves unfolding from the soil
flower buds on bent stems with their three leaf-bracts
flower: a low carpet of ferny divided leaves
flat daisy-like pink flowers held just above them, each with a whorl of three leaf-bracts below
seedhead: a small round knob of seeds on a bending stem
divided leaves still green round it

look_alikes: Wood anemone (Anemonoides nemorosa) has six or seven broader white tepals and leaves less finely cut. Anemone apennina is very similar but its leaves are hairy beneath. Lesser celandine has glossy heart-shaped leaves and yellow flowers.
